summary: add T112 in P06 as the legal successor repair task for the three defects A0026 confirmed in the code paths that produce new T109 artifacts, and record the impact on the T110, T111 and Web (T084/T087/T088) dependency chain that depends on those artifacts
rationale: A0026 confirmed three defects in the approved T109 (commit c79e4c83, review-004 PASS) implementation, not in its contract: (a) the product backtest entry wired through src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py accepts an `EventSource` and a coverage record without resolving the dataset's real T100 partitions, so a fixed empty event source can still feed T061 (Owner: '产品回测入口必须从真实 T100 分区经既有 replay/features 进入 T061，不得使用固定空事件源'); (b) src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py:2041 `_derive_partition_refs` fabricates the manifest's `dataset_partition_refs` from cursor triples (`f'{cursor[0]:010d}-{cursor[1]:06d}-{cursor[2]:06d}'`, :2069) or, when no event carries a cursor, from a synthetic `coverage-{covered_start:05d}-{covered_end:05d}` string (:2074) — neither resolves to the same canonical bytes T100 registered (Owner: 'manifest 必须引用真实且可解析到相同 canonical bytes 的 T100 partition refs，不得由事件游标或 coverage 字符串伪造'); (c) src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py:2222-2223 and :2242-2243 construct initial and final `PositionState` with `tick_lower=request.block_range_start, tick_upper=request.block_range_end`, writing block range into tick range, and src/robinhood_lp/orchestrator/__init__.py:2201-2214 build a `RunStateCheckpoint` with `equity_q64_64=0, drawdown_q64_64=0` and an `attribution_snapshot` whose every component is zero, so the simulation evidence cannot restore position, integer inventory, equity, drawdown or T052 attribution at the actual fill cursor (Owner: 'simulation evidence 不得把 block range 写入 tick range，必须保存足以在实际 fill cursor 恢复仓位、整数库存、净值、回撤与 T052 归因的运行事实'). The fix belongs to a new PLANNED successor that PROPHET is the only layer that may create, so A0026 adds T112 in P06 with status PLANNED, depends_on [T040, T041, T052, T061, T100, T104, T109] (T112 repairs T109's wiring, so it builds on the same reconstruction, attribution, engine, dataset registry and fee-projection edges T109 and T110 already carry), replaces [T109], and an explicit `Replacement and migration` section naming every successor-consumer rewiring obligation and the historical-immutability guarantee for T069, T105 and T109 evidence, candidate commits and review records. T109's contract, status, attempts, base/candidate/approved SHAs, evidence pointer and review-004 record stay byte-identical; T110, T111, T084, T087 and T088 keep their PLANNED contracts and current dependency edges to T109, recording in this result the obligation that future CONTRACT amendments repoint them to T112 once T112 is APPROVED and T109 is SUPERSEDED. No existing task contract is modified; no `docs/intent/` document is touched; `docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §2.2 only gains prospective T112 successor annotations on T109's two ownership rows; no governing Spec requirement changes; no file under `src/`, `tests/`, `.github/`, `tools/workflow/`, `.claude/`, `todo/schemas/` or the dependency manifests is modified.

impact_assessment.intent: Not applicable. `docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md` is not touched. `intent_revision` stays at `v1-2026-09-21-historical-and-run-replay`. A0026 does not restate any goal, product boundary, V1 scope, acceptance gate, or live-promotion rule; the repair task operates entirely inside the existing G-BACKTEST-RUN-01, G-HISTORICAL-REPLAY-01, G-RUN-REPLAY-01, G-BACKTEST-RESULT-01 and G-NUMERAIRE-01/02 obligations that T109 already inherits, so the project intent stays the same intent T109 is reviewed against.
impact_assessment.specification: Derived ownership-map annotation only: `docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §2.2 now names T112 as T109's prospective successor in its two T109 rows, expressly keeping T109 current until formal retirement. `spec_revision` stays at `v1-2026-09-21-section-2-2-module-attribution`. The T109 contract's `References` already cite `G-BACKTEST-RUN-01`, `G-RUN-REPLAY-01`, `G-BACKTEST-RESULT-01`, `docs/spec/research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md` (DS-001, DS-002, DS-005–DS-007), `docs/spec/strategy/LP_METRICS.md`, T052, T061, T069, T100, T104, T105 and T110, ADR-006, ADR-014 and R17; T112 inherits the same references and adds M-BE-001 / M-LVR-001 / M-BM-002 plus T052 attribution. The three rules A0026 records are already stated in those clauses (real partition refs that resolve to the same canonical bytes T100 registered; no block range in tick range; fill-cursor preservation of position / integer inventory / equity / drawdown / T052 attribution) and T112 is the contract that makes the implementation obey them. No binding product, strategy, operations or security clause changes, and no `docs/implement/` document changes. T069, T105, T110 and T111 architecture rows stay byte-identical; T109's two rows carry only the prospective successor annotation required by the citation rule. The `spec_revision` stays unchanged because this is derived ownership metadata, not a specification requirement change.

impact_assessment.dependencies: One new dependency edge added: `T109 → T112`, plus six supporting edges `T040, T041, T052, T061, T100, T104 → T112`. T112 depends on T109 because the repair task builds on the T109 causal-schedule, cursor-binding and atomic-publication invariants and on the T100 partition registry, T040/T041 reconstruction, T061 engine / accounting semantics and T052 attribution those invariants rely on. T112 also depends on T104 because T110's acceptance (which the A0026 simulation-evidence tests must satisfy alongside the T112 ones) composes T104's dataset/window/cursor-bound fee-growth projection, and the repaired evidence surface must remain compatible with T104's provenance. The downstream chain T109 → T110 → T111 and T068 → T084 → T087 / T088 keeps its current dependency edges; T112's contract records the obligation that every PLANNED direct consumer of T109 (T073, T084, T085, T086, T087, T088, T103, T107, T108, T110, T111) becomes a future-CONTACT-amendment repointing target from T109 to T112 once T112 is APPROVED and T109 is annotated `superseded_by T112`. T112 stays PLANNED with `attempt=0` until that repointing completes; while T109 stays APPROVED, every PLANNED consumer's contract and `depends_on` field is unchanged. No cycle introduced; `tools.workflow validate` remains OK after the new entry. T096's transitive closure across the existing V1 matrix is unaffected because the matrix names the historical T069, T105 and T109 evidence and the new T112 evidence as successor coverage rather than as additional obligations.
impact_assessment.implementation: Not applicable in this PROPHET amendment. The Owner direction targets planning, not implementation. The implementation repair — replacing `_derive_partition_refs` so it resolves real T100 partitions from the dataset's immutable registry rather than fabricating cursor-triple or coverage-record strings; replacing the orchestrator's `submit()` `EventSource` argument with a T100 partition resolver wired through the existing T040/T041 replay and T049 features paths so the fixed empty event source becomes non-current; replacing `_build_simulation_evidence`'s `PositionState` construction so `tick_lower` and `tick_upper` no longer carry `block_range_start` and `block_range_end`; replacing the `RunStateCheckpoint` zero-valued `equity_q64_64`, `drawdown_q64_64` and `attribution_snapshot` with values derived from the corresponding `RunState` projection so a fill-cursor reader restores position, integer inventory, equity, drawdown and T052 attribution; and adding the `T112_PARTITION_REF_UNRESOLVABLE`, `T112_TICK_OUT_OF_RANGE`, `T112_BLOCK_RANGE_IN_TICK_RANGE`, and `T112_RUN_FACTS_MISSING` named reason codes — is the work T112's developer attempt will perform inside its own task contract, after the Manager explicitly chooses T112 and `tools.workflow ready` verifies every dependency and phase entry condition. No file under `src/`, `tests/`, `.github/`, `tools/workflow/`, `.claude/`, `todo/schemas/`, `pyproject.toml`, `requirements.in` or `requirements.lock.txt` is touched by this amendment.
impact_assessment.data: No persisted-data semantics change at the plan level. Historical T069, T105 and T109 manifests, reports, simulation evidence, candidate locks, search manifests, robustness reports, review artifacts, approval commits (`4731b626` T069, `f913d44b` T105, `c79e4c83` T109), evidence pointers and review records stay byte-identical and read-only; their exact `RunState` stays explicitly unavailable (the `T109_HISTORICAL_UNAVAILABLE` named reason code remains in `src/robinhood_lp/reports/validation.py:699-712`). No new persisted artifact, schema version, manifest version, evidence schema, partition layout or storage path is created by this amendment. The T100 dataset registry, the T104 fee-growth projection, the T040 / T041 reconstruction and the T109 simulation-evidence schema stay byte-identical; new runs started after T112 is APPROVED publish only through the repaired surfaces and their on-disk layout matches today's T109 artifacts (T112 neither renames nor relocates them).
impact_assessment.operations: Not applicable. The controller's `active_task` stays T109, `active_phase` stays P06 and `workflow_state` stays APPROVED. T112 sits as PLANNED with `attempt=0` under P06 and inherits the standard transition rules; it is not eligible for `ready` until the Manager explicitly chooses it and the controller verifies every dependency and phase entry condition. No CLI command, Web surface, background process, signer, executor or risk authority is affected. The PROPHET amendment does not run an experiment, does not start an ingestion, does not perform a Git write operation, does not call any RPC and does not read a private key, Keystore or `.env` file; the controller owns those surfaces and the worktree's Git state is left to the Manager / controller layer.
impact_assessment.security: Not applicable. T112 explicitly forbids granting execution, approval, risk, signer, paper or live authority; it forbids widening existing fail-closed invariants; it forbids relaxing any acceptance criterion, gate, tolerance, type, Must-not clause, suppression entry or risk limit to obtain PASS. The repaired surfaces do not introduce a credential, endpoint secret, signing payload, key material, RPC URL or authorization header. The signer process and the Web authentication path stay out of scope for T112; the repaired orchestrator wiring reads only the T100 partition bytes the dataset declares, not arbitrary RPC inputs. Tampering, partition-reference downgrade to a cursor-fabricated or coverage-fabricated string, block_range-into-tick_range cross-write, and zero-valued run-fact replacement all fail closed with the new named reason codes.
impact_assessment.verification: Not applicable in this PROPHET amendment. No verification evidence is produced; no acceptance criteria have been checked against a candidate commit, because T112 is PLANNED and no developer attempt exists yet. The acceptance clauses T112 defines — real T100 partition resolution via the existing replay/features paths, refusal of the fixed empty event source by named reason, manifest `dataset_partition_refs` resolving to the same canonical bytes T100 registered with mismatched / cursor-fabricated / coverage-fabricated references rejected by named reason, separate `block_range` and `tick_range` fields with the cursor and the reconstructed tick/liquidity/inventory/equity/drawdown/T052-attribution facts preserved at the actual fill cursor, two heterogeneous-pool fixtures, the existing T109 cursor-binding / atomic-publication / sparse-checkpoint / strategy-replacement / T052-attribution / T104-composition / legacy-unavailable / predecessor-publisher-unreachable / shared-canonical-timeline test matrix staying passing, and pytest + Ruff format/check + strict mypy + `git diff --check` clean with no secret or signing payload logged — are the contract T112's developer attempt must satisfy. Independent verification belongs to T112's develop/review cycle and to a future amendment that resolves the T112 contracts.

affected_existing_tasks.reason: T110 (PLANNED, depends_on T109) currently commits to compose `MarketState` / `RunState` / `ReplayFrame` from `T109` simulation evidence through T040 / T041 / T104. A0026 confirmed that the T109 evidence chain is currently wired through `_derive_partition_refs` (cursor-fabricated or coverage-fabricated `dataset_partition_refs`), a fixed empty `EventSource` entry and `PositionState.tick_lower/tick_upper` filled from `block_range_start/end` with zero-valued `equity_q64_64`, `drawdown_q64_64` and `attribution_snapshot`. A reader of T110's contract that trusts it to compose real canonical partition refs and fill-cursor run facts from T109 evidence would be misled while these defects stand; T110's `RunState` projection would be projecting zero equity, zero drawdown, zero attribution and a tick range that mirrors the block range. T109's contract stays correct; the defect is in the T109 implementation. Without T112, T110's `depends_on T109` is a contract that names an evidence shape the current implementation does not deliver.
